missing_api: There is no CLR AppDomain-compatible cross-domain Migrant serialization API.
There is no Migrant version-tolerant deserializer for changed assemblies and member layouts.
The monitor has no reflection-driven action binder for optional, named, array and variadic arguments on the fixture's test emulation object.
There is no dynamic CLR command auto-registration or runtime loading of C# extension methods.
CAST_CANCTRL peripheral, acceptance filters and message buffers are absent.

All five cases need KeyManager command, working-state, status and write-one-to-clear error registers. The fixture advances through the creator and owner derivation states, which require the ROM-controller digest and KMAC-256 over the configured keys and seeds.
OpenTitan SPI Device flash passthrough and FIFO model are absent.
SD controllers lack an eMMC card model with CMD6 partition switching, EXT_CSD transfer, and separate user and boot areas.

Remaining cases need duplicate dictionary-key exception chaining, additional collection binding, initialization execution and existing sysbus dependencies, general mock registration and lifecycle binding, and upstream multiline edge behavior for lone end-of-line escaped delimiters and a missing delimiter between quoted values.

Remaining cases require non-CPU factories beyond EmptyPeripheral and MockExternal, inline factories for additional mock models, registration-point compatibility and protected/injected constructor handling beyond the covered mocks, IRQ wiring and metadata, and constructor and collection binding.
The Rust Python peripheral subset lacks IronPython object-state serialization across reload.
Memory snapshots do not serialize a whole emulation graph with the fixture's machine, peripherals, relationships and event state.
There is no in-process compilation and loading of arbitrary C# source into the emulator.
